packedDone.qualification: Process-lifetime V8 sampling includes startup and all fork workers; profiled runs are diagnostic not performance acceptance; native sampled attribution may be opaque.

hotspots.qualification: Three fresh profiled packed runs per mode, median weighted sample milliseconds. Inclusive paths overlap and must not be summed. Sampling does not give exact CPU duration.

nativeBoundaries.qualification: Private metadata-only wrappers around existing native calls; no extra native invocation. Timings include NAPI conversion and native work, exclude argument preparation and wrapper recording. Instrumented diagnostic only.

nativeSample.qualification: Main-thread sample counts, not invocation counts or elapsed milliseconds. Inclusive categories overlap. Exclusive phases are heuristic by symbol ancestry and include callees/allocations; optimized/inlined frames may be absent.

replay.qualification: Authentic six fresh native models, matching installs/replacements and118 requests per replay. Both baseline and candidate invoke the SAME native-state-v1 method and exact projection wires. Every exact response/error validated outside timing; only internal successful projection retention differs. Includes actual NAPI native retained-state/cache cost, compile/prepare/dispose; excludes JS capture/DTO encoding/application. No packed parity inference.

nativeReplay.qualification: Native symbols from actual accepted optimized addon. Repeats six fresh models and 118 captured requests; compile/prepare/dispose included. Excludes JS DOM capture, request encoding and app work. This is sampled attribution, not packed speed or exact invocation counts.

profileInvalidation.reason: All29tests passed but CPU profiles contain only six workers; inputs.test.jsx worker profile absent. Excluded from aggregation and rerun.

boundaryCorrection.reason: First diagnostic used incorrect template method names and omitted runtime preference exports; no missing calls claimed as zero. Retain raw first run; repeat all modes with exact exports from src/css_backend.rs.

qualification: Diagnostic profiles and separately instrumented native boundaries, not new speed acceptance. Three complete packed profiles per mode. Sample time/categories overlap where noted. Native replay excludes JS capture/encoding and includes cold compile/metadata work.
